These Lua files are fixed output baselines for the inputs created by `make_fixture()` in `tests/support.py`. They were generated by the original scripts from commit `c9e6caa`. Tests compare the Python generator's output with these files byte-for-byte.

| Baseline | Original entry point |
| --- | --- |
| `auto-zh.lua` | `generator-zh` |
| `manual-zh.lua` | `generator-zh_manualsource` |
| `auto-lzh.lua` | `generator-lzh` |
| `manual-lzh.lua` | `generator-lzh_manualsource` |

Tests read these files without regenerating them. A changed output needs to be checked against the intended behavior before updating a baseline. The original scripts remain available in Git history for historical comparisons.
